name: Avoid cross-contamination
description: The adversary is avoiding cross-contamination between his internet usage, identities, and so on to prevent correlation of actions which could lead to de-anonymization.

subtechniques.name: Colour VM's
subtechniques.description: In Qubes OS qubes might receive a colored border to keep track of the domain in which it runs. This helps the individual of keeping track of their corresponding security level and preventing making mistakes.
